title: Hearty Midnight Cravings Norwegian Kabanos Tagine
description: A unique fusion of Norwegian and Mediterranean flavors featuring tender kabanos in a rich miso marinade, slow-cooked to perfection in a ceramic tagine.

ingredients.name: Miso Paste
ingredients.notes: White or yellow miso works well.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's translucent and starting to caramelize, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the kabanos and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a large ceramic tagine and add the miso paste, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Brush the inside of the tagine with the remaining olive oil and cover the lid with a piece of parchment paper, allowing steam to escape.
Transfer the tagine to the oven and cook at 300°F (150°C) for 20 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley and cilantro. If desired, drizzle with honey.
Let the kabanos tagine rest, covered, for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
